links.surface: أبي أبى ابن امرأة، عبادة بن الصامت

notes: two «ح» branches, each with its own full names: two groups and no shared tail
«- المعنى -» is an editor's gloss and is left out; «عن سفيان» is a link

the nephew of the Companion is written as «ابن أخت، عبادة بن الصامت» and «أبي أبى ابن امرأة، عبادة بن الصامت»: the text joins him to the Companion's name with a comma, so the exact boundary of the nephew's name needs a ruling; the Companion is the last link of each route (occurrences 2 and 4)
the text's «أبي أبى» is irregular and may be garbled; read as written
